description: Evidence-driven AI/software forensics, supervised engineering, and progressive roadmap evaluation with governed adaptive development.

defaultPrompt: Forensically audit this system and design evidence-backed improvements.
interface.longDescription: A.S.F.R.E.E coordinates authorized AI/software forensics and supervised engineering through M00 and canonical specialists O01–O12. RPEDS adds a governed roadmap lifecycle control plane for phased development, milestones, iterations, evidence-based progress, evaluation checkpoints and adaptive replanning. O11 retains security/authorization; O12 retains evaluation judgment; O10 retains verification. The 0.5.0-rc.1 candidate provides portable skills, reference modules, schemas and acceptance specifications, not a deployed roadmap runtime or automatic synchronization service.
